_comment: Go route to underlying-model identity reconciliation (committed; verified name-identity only). When a mapping exists, select-model.ps1 may borrow the underlying canonical capability evidence downgraded one confidence step as a cautious prior, labeled as such in why. Subscription pool economics always stay on the Go route itself. Missing mapping falls back to unknown-capability rules (ordinary tasks require positive evidence or qualifying history; trivial admits with evaluation_only flag; consequential requires positive evidence).
